svg.title: The parts of Deep32
svg.desc: Five badges. Headend: your agent, Claude Code or Codex, on your PC. Workstation: search and archive, OpenBSD with the gateway and the Library, disc 1. Forge: the GPU powerhouse for embedding, reranking and converting, disc 3. Ask relay: the link between the Ask window and your agent, on your PC. Content: the library of RFCs, Cisco documentation and a prebuilt index, disc 2.
